title: Implant purpose and bloodline hybrid program

tellings.quote: Um that it was a medical monitoring device is my understanding uh to or monitor things like blood sugar and body temperature and things like that.

plain: An object said to be an alien implant found in a human body was, in the understanding of a scientist named Steve Colbern, a medical monitoring device that tracked things like blood sugar and body temperature. Colbern, who studies such implants, tells Michels this in a conversation that ties the implants to a hybrid programme said to run along family bloodlines, though the excerpt gives no details of that programme.
